trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Pure-data table(); no trap verdict per the batch spec. Read in full: a 4x2 structural analogy table (mass vs coupling) with no numerics to recompute. trap-negation-contrast.notes: One incompleteness worth an author look: the 'Divisor correction' cell gives the coupling correction as (CS_1 + CS_2) * hbar_q^2, but the actual delta_CS defined in prop:em-coupling-projection's discussion and in rem:em-coupling-chern-simons is (CS_1 + CS_2) * ([2]_q/2) * hbar_q^2 / (q[9]_q[10]_q). The [2]_q/2 factor and the normalisation are dropped. Acceptable as a schematic analogy, but a reader who takes the cell literally gets a number 1.005x too large before normalisation. Proposed fix: write the cell as '(CS_1+CS_2)*([2]_q/2)*hbar_q^2 (force-carrier blow-up centres, normalised by the base term)'.
